notes.title: Steam Deck Verified!
notes.notes: [p]Howdy partners,[/p][p]After a few small tweak to text legibility, Coyote is now officially Steam Deck Verified! Take this short tale from the old west along on your next trip, or just curl up on the couch and take in the atmosphere. Plus, a MacOS version is coming soon.[/p]

notes.title: Patch 2.1
notes.notes:
- FIXED: hotspot label can no longer appear (partially) offscreen when cursor is close to screen edge
- FIXED: NPC names in dialogues now also respond to large font setting
- IMPROVED: controller glyphs now also scale along with the large font size setting

notes.title: My new game is now available!
notes.notes: [p]Howdy partners,[/p][p]Thanks so much to all 25.000+ of you that checked out Coyote. It really means a lot that you all took time to play my little indie game.[/p][p]I wanted to let you know that I have a new game out right now, just as bite-sized as Coyote, also taking place in the desert, and this one is all about exploring an old ruin (and not dying in the process).[/p][p]Hope you enjoy it![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3775390/The_Ruin_Wanderer/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
